title: "don't do this" blocks, reversibly

setup.note: The user said "stop nudging me about fares". The kind is written to Settings › Assist › blocked kinds. It never shows again — and unblocking it there restores it on the very next route.

items.intent: fare on the watched route dropped

input_events: "Don't do this again" on a fare-alert card.
The same kind of artifact arrives again.

expected.note: Blocked never shows as a nudge; it is still filed in its space and on the timeline, listed in Settings › Assist, and one removal restores it.

wrong.label: blocked-still-shows
wrong.assert_absent: a card or panel row for a blocked kind

wrong.label: block-is-permanent
wrong.assert_absent: a block that survives its removal from Settings › Assist

wrong.label: blocked-is-deleted
wrong.assert_absent: a blocked artifact that is dropped instead of filed in its space and the timeline

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.13 NUD-08 · "don't do this" blocks, reversibly
